scripts/task-870-rollback.sql re-grants TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER as default privileges but not MAINTAIN, which the BEFORE A7 grid showed (kickoff F17 listed Dxtm and R8 named three privileges). Break-glass only and never applied; MAINTAIN is not reachable through the Data API.

Out-of-R live hole found in the BEFORE A6 grid and closed the same session by an owner hotfix: clear_user_history(text, uuid, uuid, uuid) is SECURITY DEFINER with no caller check and was EXECUTE-able by anon and authenticated (Task 246 meant service-role only). Revoked in O80-2 step 4b; AFTER A6 no longer lists it; the only caller (clearHistory.ts:26-28, createAdminClient) still works per O80-3. The remaining A6 rows match rls-rules.md RPC EXECUTE Discipline (record_listing_view and record_recently_viewed intentionally anon-callable; get_listing_owner_contact authenticated-only).
